validation_scope.device_gpu_npu_verification: Galaxy S26 (Adreno) GPU measured for the Android placement (see README, Android); Pixel 8a NOT_RUN; NPU NOT_RUN
validation_scope.raw_fp16_embedding_warning: The raw float16 tables are a storage option. Existing quality measurements used the original float32 NPZ tables; casting raw float16 tables back to float32 does not restore those values.

reference.tested_preparation: Load, mono, resample to 24 kHz, normalize_reference on the full clip, take its first 240000 samples. Inputs were at least ten seconds.
reference.host_short_input_policy: A host may zero-pad to 240000 samples; short-input padding is not tested here. Upstream prepare_reference does not define this deterministic bucket.
reference.crop_on_pause: bypassed to exclude random room tone

autoregressive.text_limit_note: The upstream metadata cap of 2048 is not the static graph limit. Reject or explicitly segment text when the complete prefix exceeds 256 positions.
autoregressive.cache_update: Step attention replaces slot p with the current key/value before attention. Host writes returned new_k/new_v to position p in its packed caches.
autoregressive.step_bias_precondition: Valid slots are contiguous from zero through p inclusive; all later slots are invalid. Runtime bias is zero for valid keys and -10000 for invalid keys.
autoregressive.rope: Host rotate_half cos/sin tables; step shapes [1,1,1,64]

sampling.rng: NumPy generator; one uniform draw and inverse CDF per sampled token
sampling.eos: masked until the source minimum step count of ten
sampling.terminal_rule: Stop on EOS or count limit; do not run AR step after the final sampled token.

acoustic.padding: Zero tokens and frames outside their actual lengths. token_mask zeros padded embeddings; key_bias is -10000 at padded keys. Ignore padded queries.
acoustic.bucket_limit_note: Acoustic capacities are independent of the 1024-position AR cache and the source 30-second generation limit; all limits apply.
acoustic.host_solver: Use float32 x0. Evaluate velocity at t0, update x by (t1-t0) * velocity, then re-mask the reference prompt with (1 - (1 - sigma_min) * t1) * x0 + t1 * cond_mel. After the final step replace the prompt region with cond_mel exactly.

offline.padding: Mask the residual after embed LayerNorm and after every ConvNeXt block.

streaming.short_input_note: The fixed-64 host tail replay requires at least 128 real mel frames. It does not support every short output; ten generated tokens plus context is only 72 frames. Use an explicitly supported offline path for shorter inputs.

istft.algorithm: irfft, multiply Hann, overlap-add, divide window-square envelope, crop 512 samples at both ends

host_steps: embedding lookup, RoPE, attention bias and packed KV writes
two-step Euler solve with prompt re-masking
log-magnitude exponentiation/clamp, phase synthesis and iSTFT
output_gain, trim_lead, trim_trail, soft_limit and fade_edges
host_fft_precision_note: The acoustic float32 mirror uses np.fft.rfft(windowed, norm="forward") * np.float32(1024). The default NumPy 2.5.3 rfft dispatch can select a float64 loop for this call shape and alter downstream flow conditioning.
signature_order_note: Buffer order below is the emitted SignatureDef order, not subgraph tensor order. Use signature names to disambiguate equally shaped inputs.
weight_precision_note: Plain wfp16 casts eligible constants to float16 with float compute; it has no vocoder output-head exception. Native int8 is provided only for merged AR.
